# WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace Documentation

> Official documentation for Webkul's WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace plugin, which converts a WooCommerce store into a multi-vendor marketplace with vendor dashboards, commissions, payouts, and shipping.

**When to use this documentation.** Use this site when you need to:

- Install or update the WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace plugin on a WordPress site (system requirements, upload, activation).
- Configure marketplace behavior: general settings, product settings, endpoints, commission rates, withdrawal rules, vendor invoices, Seller Central, Google Analytics.
- Answer how-to questions about vendor workflows: registration, dashboard, product management, orders, transactions, payouts, shipping zones, staff, KYC, vacation mode.
- Answer how-to questions about admin workflows: vendor approval and management, product assignment, commissions, feedback and queries, notifications, email configuration.
- Troubleshoot marketplace setup on an existing WooCommerce store using this specific Webkul plugin.

Do not use this site for WooCommerce core documentation, other marketplace plugins, or Webkul's Magento/Shopify products.

**How to consume this site.** Every documentation page is available as raw markdown: append `.md` to the page URL (e.g. `https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/installation.md`), or request any HTML URL with `Accept: text/markdown`. The full corpus in one file: [llms-full.txt](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/llms-full.txt). Machine-readable page list: [sitemap.xml](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/sitemap.xml).

- [What are the requirements?](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/knowledge-base/getting-started/requirements.md): "Minimum WordPress, WooCommerce, PHP, memory, and SSL versions for the WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace plugin."

- [Do I need to update permalinks?](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/knowledge-base/getting-started/update-permalinks.md): "Why you must re-save permalinks as Post Name after installing the WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace plugin."

- [Marketplace menu is missing after activation](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/knowledge-base/troubleshooting/marketplace-menu-missing.md): "Fix for the missing Marketplace admin menu after activating the WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace plugin."
- [Vendor / marketplace pages return 404](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/knowledge-base/troubleshooting/vendor-pages-404.md): "Fix 404 Not Found errors on vendor dashboard, shop, and Seller Central pages by re-saving permalinks."
- [Fatal error or white screen when activating](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/knowledge-base/troubleshooting/fatal-error-on-activation.md): "Fix a fatal error, white screen, or memory error when activating the WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace plugin."
- [License activation fails](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/knowledge-base/troubleshooting/license-activation-failed.md): "Fix license key activation errors for the WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace plugin."
- [Shop URL always shows "Already Exists" at registration](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/knowledge-base/troubleshooting/shop-url-already-exists.md): "Fix the vendor registration Shop URL field reporting Already Exists for every value."
- [How do vendors register?](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/knowledge-base/vendors/how-vendors-register.md): "The ways a seller can register as a vendor on the WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace."
- [How are commissions handled?](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/knowledge-base/vendors/commission-basics.md): "A short overview of marketplace commissions in the WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace plugin."
- [Before you open a ticket](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/knowledge-base/billing-support/before-you-open-a-ticket.md): "A short checklist to get a faster answer from Webkul support for the WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace plugin."
- [Pricing, refunds & support](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/knowledge-base/billing-support/pricing-refunds-support.md): "Pricing, license, refund policy, and support hours for the WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace plugin."
